“Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, the Son — and the Holy Spirit.” — Matt 28:19  

The kingdom is not a future hope; it is a command to act now under Christ’s authority. Every step you take in obedience expands God’s reign here and now.  

What kingdom‑building step is God calling you to take today?
